experiment: Exploratory state-balanced checkpoint selection for PoL2 contract SFT

design.scope: narrow synthetic operationalization, contract v0.2; not complete PoL2
design.status: exploratory follow-up; test lattice and prior scores were public before this selection rule was chosen
design.training_change: checkpoint selected by mean validation NLL with exactly equal representation for each of 10 supported typed states (5 rows/state)
limitations: The test was already public and previously examined; this is exploratory, not independent confirmation.
Only the finite synthetic contract v0.2 lattice is tested; not complete PoL2 or physical robotics.
Labels and legal-action sets derive from one operationalization, not independent normative ground truth.
The lattice contains no held-out positive transfer target.
Three seeds are descriptive and insufficient for a population-level causal claim.
